findings.desc: [MEDIUM] Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md:21-28 and :186 call the second-round host synthesis/manual transcript an evidence input, but :58 says host transcript "cannot satisfy verificationEvidence". That wording is too absolute and drifts from current Koala semantics: this story already records CHK-001 as manual_transcript verificationEvidence via checklist_get. Narrow the claim to authority/gate/validation scope (for example, not authoritative lifecycle truth, not review pass, not delivery check, not koala validate evidence) so readers do not misread manual transcript evidence as categorically invalid.
